Title: TOM: Question on new clans in expansion

Messages.Author: Guy Keen
Messages.Body:
Tom, from one of your earlier threads, you intimated that the 2 new
clans, Ravnos & Giovanni, were going to introduce 2 new disciplines.
My question: Do WOTC plan to add 1 or 2 vampires to some/all existing
clans, that will have some skill in these new disciplines? Otherwise I
fear the gap between existing and new clans will be too discrete. Just
a thought,

***Hungry Wolf***

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Guy Keen <g...@hceltd.demon.co.uk> wrote:
>Tom, from one of your earlier threads, you intimated that the 2 new
>clans, Ravnos & Giovanni, were going to introduce 2 new disciplines.
>My question: Do WOTC plan to add 1 or 2 vampires to some/all existing

>clans, that will have some skill in these new disciplines?...

Dark Sovereigns will have vampires from the existing clans (and Caitiff),
and some of those vampires will have one or both of the new disciplines.

Messages.Body:
